nodes.label: shadcn CLI Reference
nodes.rationale: Full flag reference for init/add/search/view/docs/info/build; only documented flags exist, preset codes are opaque and passed directly, and the CLI auto-detects the package manager from the lockfile.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Preview and Smart Merge
nodes.rationale: add --dry-run/--diff/--view previews resolved paths, diffs, and CSS updates without writing files, preferred over fetching raw files from GitHub; updates with local changes are merged file-by-file, and --overwrite is never used without explicit user approval.
